QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Landscape and Types_19

question.text: Per the Preqin projections cited in the chapter, the global alternative investment market is projected to grow significantly, exceeding approximately USD ____ trillion in AUM by ____.

explanation.text: The Logic: XIX-D pp. 45-46 cite Preqin: the global AIF market was at USD 13 trillion in 2021 and is expected to grow to USD 23 trillion by 2026. A 2025 update forecasts that the global alternative investment market will exceed USD 30 trillion in AUM by 2030. The Trap: USD 5 trillion by 2026 is wrong, USD 13 trillion / 2021 is the historical data point rather than the projection, and USD 100 trillion / 2035 is fabricated. Note: The Preqin projection of roughly USD 30 trillion in global alternatives AUM by 2030 is one of the headline figures the workbook uses to size the opportunity set.
